## Features
- Ip65 weatherproof led string lights
- Connectable up to 100m lighting system
- Durable cable for indoor outdoor use

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.

## Features
- Compact 100cm maypole tree for indoor and outdoor festive displays
- 146 LEDs across eight light strings and an illuminated star topper
- White, warm white, or multi-colour LEDs with eight modes and memory
- Battery powered with timer; requires 3 x AA batteries (not included)
- Ready-assembled base and four ground stakes for secure lawn display

## Information
Bring an eye-catching festive glow to your home or garden with the Christow Battery-Powered LED Maypole Christmas Tree. Standing 100cm tall, it has eight illuminated strings arranged beneath a glowing star to create a classic tree-shaped silhouette. Choose white, warm white, or multi-colour micro LEDs to match your Christmas theme, with eight light modes adding variety to the display. Requiring no mains socket, it’s easy to position on a lawn, patio, entranceway, or inside your home. Classic Maypole Silhouette Eight strings sweep from the illuminated star topper down to the base, creating an enchanting maypole tree silhouette. Each string contains 17 micro LEDs, with 10 more inside the star. Together, the 146 micro LEDs create an eye-catching festive glow. 8 Light Modes with Memory From subtle glows to livelier effects, cycle through eight different lighting modes to set the perfect festive mood. A built-in memory function conveniently recalls your previous selection, so the tree is always ready to shine your way when it’s switched back on. Battery Powered with Built-In Timer An IP44-rated battery box powers the tree, allowing you to position it without a nearby mains socket. A 1m black lead connects the battery box to the base, while the timer switches the lights on at the same time each evening before turning them off six hours later. Quick Assembly & Outdoor Stability The base arrives ready-assembled to reduce setup time. Simply join the pole sections, then connect the light strings from the star topper to the base. Four U-shaped ground stakes help anchor the tree securely on soft ground – ideal for a lawn display. Product Specifications Product Type: Battery-Powered LED Maypole Christmas Tree Height: 100cm Base Size: 35cm Star Size: 10cm Total LEDs: 146 Light Strings: 8 LEDs per String: 17 LEDs in Star: 10 LED Colours: White, warm white, or multi-colour Light Modes: 8 Memory Function: Remembers the last setting selected Timer: 6 hours on / 18 hours off Power: Battery powered Battery Box: IP44-rated Batteries: Requires 3 x AA batteries (not included) Lead-Wire Length: 1m Lead-Wire Colour: Black Assembly: Ready-assembled base with joining pole sections Ground Stakes: 4 x U-shaped stakes included Usage: Suitable for indoor and outdoor display
